about: T-513 and T-516 (DRAFT): THE SUBTLE LAYER, held. T-516 A3: the INTERPRETER in SAFFRON, THE LOG holding ten reads given, goes on "Did they agree to it?". M2: a CHECKPOINT heal; under "We hope to see you again!" the purple box reads "Not too soon." and then "It was already mending.". S1: on a SATURDAY (gDaemonsWeekdayOverride 7) THE LOG opens "SATURDAY. Who was looking?" above the counts. B1 (no WRITE until seven reads given) changes a number in a battle's damage and says nothing, so it has no stop. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's; the day is put back at the end.
